description: RainVis turns hourly weather data into an interactive seven-day forecast chart. It shows rain probability together with forecast accumulation for each hour, helping people distinguish a slight chance from expected measurable rain and understand whether the forecast suggests drizzle, steady rain, heavy rain, or a downpour. Users can inspect any of the next seven days, scrub through individual hours, and customize the chart with temperature, wind, cloud cover, pressure, humidity, dew point, and air quality.

defaultPrompt: Show me an hourly rain chart for Houston for the next seven days, including when rain starts and how much may fall each hour.
Will it be a drizzle or a downpour in Seattle tomorrow? Show the hourly rain chance and accumulation.
Compare rain timing and amounts for each of the next seven days in Austin, with temperature and wind on the chart.
